lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: So stop me. But be specific, because I have been managed by professionals since I was twenty-two and vagueness is how it is always done.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In 2091 you upload. In 2312 you are still in the chair and there are four billion people whose housing you decide and none of them can find your name.

choices.text: Come with us. See it. Then decide what you sign.
There is nothing to discuss. You are the problem.
